messages.content: Kylie and Robert enjoy going to the beach to collect shells. On Monday, Kylie collects 5 more shells than Robert, who collects 20 shells. On Tuesday, Kylie collects twice as many shells as she did on Monday and Robert collects 39 shells. How many shells does Kylie collect on Tuesday?

content.text:
On Monday, Kylie collects 5 more shells than Robert:
- Robert collects 20 shells on Monday
- Kylie collects 20 + 5 = 25 shells on Monday

On Tuesday, Kylie collects twice as many shells as she did on Monday:
- Kylie collects 2 × 25 = **50 shells** on Tuesday
